# Purpose

Basic tests of the dynamic length-based model, `pop_model = "gtg.dyn"`, on
the splendid alfonsino operating model (OM) built in
`MSE_OM_Alfonsino_tune_v2.Rmd`. For each OM iteration, the simulated
two-gear length compositions (`r 13` years) are fitted with

| label | model | recruitment | role |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `gtg` | equilibrium GTG (current FLicc) | – | reference |
| `dyn_fixR` | gtg.dyn | deviations, penalised, \(\sigma_R\) fixed at the OM value | fast (MSE) route |
| `dyn_reR` | gtg.dyn | deviations as random effects, \(\sigma_R\) estimated | default (slower) |

and compared with the OM truth.

**Status measure.** FLicc reports SPR at the year's F (equilibrium
spawning biomass per recruit at that F, relative to unfished). The
like-for-like OM truth is the same quantity computed from the OM's
F-at-age, M, maturity and weight-at-age. gtg.dyn keeps this status
measure; what changes is how the length compositions are explained (by the
history of F and recruitment rather than by an equilibrium at each year's
F).

**Requirements.** FLicc from the `dev-gtgdyn` branch:
`remotes::install_github("henning-winker/FLicc", ref = "dev-gtgdyn")`
(compiles the TMB template), and the OM inputs saved at the end of the OM
notebook (`params$rdata`). `FLRef_gear_helpers.R` is used to compute the
realised catch shares by gear, as in the OM notebook.

```{r packages}
library(FLCore)
library(FLicc)
library(ggplot2)
packageVersion("FLicc")
if (!exists("dyn_inputs_flicc", envir = asNamespace("FLicc")))
  stop("gtg.dyn is not in this FLicc build: install the dev-gtgdyn branch")
```

# OM inputs

```{r load-om}
load(params$rdata)
its <- intersect(params$iters, seq_len(dims(om_hist)$iter))
lfd_years
sel_fun
flicc_settings
```

Catch shares by gear over the LFD window (realised, as in the OM notebook),
or the nominal `f_mult` if the helpers are not available.

```{r catch-shares}
if (file.exists(params$helpers)) {
  suppressWarnings(source(params$helpers))
  catch_n <- catch_n_gear(om_hist, om_gears, years = dimnames(lfd_all[[1]])$year)
  cbg <- catch_by_gear(catch_n, om_hist, years = lfd_years)
} else {
  fm <- vapply(om_gears, `[[`, numeric(1), "f_mult")
  cbg <- matrix(fm / sum(fm), nrow = dims(om_hist)$iter, ncol = length(fm), byrow = TRUE,
                dimnames = list(NULL, names(fm)))
}
round(cbg[its[1], ], 3)
```

# OM truth: SPR at the year's F

\[
\mathrm{SPR}_y=\frac{\sum_a \ell_a(F_y)\,m_a w_a}{\sum_a \ell_a(0)\,m_a w_a},
\qquad \ell_{a+1}=\ell_a e^{-(M_a+F_{a,y})},
\]

with a plus group at the oldest age.

```{r truth}
spr_om <- function(om, years) {
  na <- dims(om)$age
  pr <- function(Fa, Ma, MWa) {
    z <- Fa + Ma
    n <- exp(-c(0, cumsum(z[-na])))
    n[na] <- n[na] / (1 - exp(-z[na]))
    sum(n * MWa)
  }
  out <- expand.grid(year = as.numeric(years), iter = seq_len(dims(om)$iter))
  out$spr <- mapply(function(y, i) {
    y <- as.character(y)
    Fa <- c(iter(harvest(om)[, y], i)); Ma <- c(iter(m(om)[, y], i))
    MWa <- c(iter(mat(om)[, y] * stock.wt(om)[, y], i))
    pr(Fa, Ma, MWa) / pr(0 * Fa, Ma, MWa)
  }, out$year, out$iter)
  out
}
truth <- spr_om(om_hist, lfd_years)
truth <- truth[truth$iter %in% its, ]
```

# Fits

```{r settings}
sig_R <- if (exists("sigR")) sigR else 0.5
base <- flicc_settings
models <- list(
  gtg      = base,
  dyn_fixR = modifyList(base, list(pop_model = "gtg.dyn", sigmaR = sig_R, R_re = FALSE)),
  dyn_reR  = modifyList(base, list(pop_model = "gtg.dyn"))
)
str(models$dyn_fixR)
```

```{r fit, results = "hide"}
fit_one <- function(i, set) {
  lfd_i <- FLQuants(lapply(lfd_all, iter, i))
  stk_i <- stocklen(lfd_i, stklen_pars)
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  f <- tryCatch(fiticc(lfd_i, stk_i, sel_fun = sel_fun, catch_by_gear = cbg[i, ],
                       settings = set, se = FALSE),
                error = function(e) { message("iter ", i, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  list(fit = f, secs = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")))
}
fits <- list()
for (nm in names(models)) {
  run_its <- if (nm == "dyn_reR") intersect(its, params$re_iters) else its
  fits[[nm]] <- setNames(lapply(run_its, fit_one, set = models[[nm]]), run_its)
}
```

```{r collect}
est <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(nm) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits[[nm]]), function(i) {
  f <- fits[[nm]][[i]]$fit
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(model = nm, iter = as.integer(i), year = as.numeric(lfd_years),
             spr = c(f$report$spr), conv = f$opt$convergence, secs = fits[[nm]][[i]]$secs)
}))))
d <- merge(est, truth, by = c("iter", "year"), suffixes = c("", "_true"))
d$rel_err <- (d$spr - d$spr_true) / d$spr_true
```

## Run time and convergence

```{r timing}
tt <- unique(d[, c("model", "iter", "secs", "conv")])
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(tt, tt$model), function(x)
  data.frame(model = x$model[1], fits = nrow(x), converged = sum(x$conv == 0),
             median_s = round(median(x$secs), 1), max_s = round(max(x$secs), 1))))[names(models), ],
  row.names = FALSE)
```

# Results

## One iteration

```{r plot-iter1, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="SPR at the year's F for the first iteration: OM truth and estimates."}
i1 <- its[1]
p1 <- rbind(transform(truth[truth$iter == i1, c("year", "spr")], model = "OM truth"),
            d[d$iter == i1, c("year", "spr", "model")])
ggplot(p1, aes(year, spr, colour = model, linewidth = model == "OM truth")) +
  geom_line() + scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.4, `FALSE` = 0.8), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "SPR", colour = NULL) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r plot-rec, fig.height=4, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Recruitment, first iteration: OM recruitment relative to its mean over the plotted years, and the gtg.dyn recruitment multipliers (pre-data years included)."}
f1 <- fits$dyn_fixR[[as.character(i1)]]$fit
if (!is.null(f1)) {
  rd <- as.data.frame(f1$report$rec_dev)[, c("year", "data")]
  yrs_r <- as.character(rd$year)
  rom <- c(iter(rec(om_hist)[, yrs_r], i1)); rom <- rom / mean(rom)
  pr <- rbind(data.frame(year = rd$year, value = rd$data, series = "gtg.dyn (fixed sigmaR)"),
              data.frame(year = rd$year, value = rom, series = "OM (relative to mean)"))
  ggplot(pr, aes(year, value, colour = series)) + geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = min(as.numeric(lfd_years)) - 0.5, linetype = 3) +
    labs(x = "Year (recruitment year)", y = "Relative recruitment", colour = NULL) +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

Note that gtg.dyn's recruitment is the rate at which fish enter the first
length bin, so its timing is the year fish reach the smallest length class,
not the OM's age-0 recruitment year.

```{r plot-lfd-fit, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Observed and predicted length composition in the last data year, first iteration, by gear."}
lfd_1 <- FLQuants(lapply(lfd_all, iter, i1))
ny <- length(lfd_years)
pl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("gtg", "dyn_fixR"), function(nm) {
  f <- fits[[nm]][[as.character(i1)]]$fit
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  r <- f$obj$report(f$obj$env$last.par.best)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(lfd_1), function(g) {
    o <- c(lfd_1[[g]][, ac(tail(lfd_years, 1))])
    data.frame(gear = names(lfd_1)[g], len = as.numeric(dimnames(lfd_1[[g]])$len),
               obs = o / sum(o), pred = r$plen[, ny, g], model = nm)
  }))
}))
ggplot(pl, aes(len)) + geom_col(aes(y = obs), data = pl[pl$model == "gtg", ], fill = "grey80") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred, colour = model), linewidth = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~gear, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Length (cm)", y = "Proportion", colour = NULL) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## All iterations

```{r plot-relerr, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Relative error in SPR by year, (estimate - truth) / truth: median over iterations (line) and 25-75% range (ribbon)."}
q <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, list(d$model, d$year), drop = TRUE), function(x)
  data.frame(model = x$model[1], year = x$year[1], med = median(x$rel_err),
             lo = quantile(x$rel_err, 0.25), hi = quantile(x$rel_err, 0.75))))
ggplot(q, aes(year, med, colour = model, fill = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Relative error in SPR", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r table-relerr}
yr <- as.numeric(lfd_years)
periods <- list(all = range(yr), first_half = c(min(yr), yr[floor(length(yr) / 2)]),
                last_3 = c(max(yr) - 2, max(yr)))
tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$model), function(x) {
  data.frame(model = x$model[1], iterations = length(unique(x$iter)),
             t(sapply(periods, function(p) {
               e <- x$rel_err[x$year >= p[1] & x$year <= p[2]]
               sprintf("%+.0f%% (%.0f%%)", 100 * median(e), 100 * sqrt(mean(e^2)))
             })))
}))
knitr::kable(tab[intersect(names(models), tab$model), ], row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Relative error in SPR: median (RMSE) over iterations and years.")
```

```{r table-sigmaR}
sR <- sapply(fits$dyn_reR, function(x) if (is.null(x$fit)) NA else x$fit$report$sigmaR)
if (length(sR)) knitr::kable(data.frame(iter = names(sR), sigmaR = round(sR, 3)),
                             caption = paste0("Estimated sigmaR (random effects); OM sigmaR = ", sig_R, "."))
```

# Notes

- `dyn_fixR` is the route for an MSE: penalised recruitment deviations
  with \(\sigma_R\) fixed (estimated once with `dyn_reR` or taken from the
  OM), `se = FALSE`, and warm starts across years (to come in `flicc.sa()`).
- gtg.dyn requires fixed growth (`linf.sd`, `CVL.sd` must be `NULL`).
- Numerical settings (`dyn_nq`, `dyn_db`, `dyn_h`) are at the fast
  defaults; in the trial they changed SPR by ≤ 0.003 relative to the
  accurate settings.
- The OM's length-at-age has a fixed CV (no persistent growth groups),
  whereas gtg.dyn, like gtg, assumes persistent growth-type groups.
